verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own OAuth implementation in which third-party applications request scoped access to user data (clerk-docs-10/44). The changelog adds a standards-based device authorization grant for CLIs, TVs and other devices (clerk-docs-52) and custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients (clerk-docs-55), so a Clerk-backed app can act as an OAuth provider issuing tokens to third-party clients. Missing for 10: explicit docs on registering third-party OAuth clients and the authorization-code/OIDC token issuance flow, consent-screen and branding details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
